en: Black‑and‑white panoramic photograph of a small rural town surrounded by fields and gentle hills. In the foreground there are trees and a simple wooden fence running along a slope; behind them stand detached wooden and brick houses with gabled roofs, barns and farm buildings. The settlement stretches into the distance with farmland and scattered houses on the horizon. In the lower right corner, handwritten text identifies the view as "Sabile …" followed by a number, suggesting a numbered postcard in a series.
